stem_book: If θ₁, θ₂ are two solutions of the equation 3cos2θ + 5sin2θ = 7 then: (P) tanθ₁ + tanθ₂ (Q) tanθ₁·tanθ₂ (R) tan(θ₁ + θ₂) (a) P > Q > R (b) P > R > Q (c) R > P > Q (d) Q < R < P
derived: c only formally (equation has no real solution)
correct_answer: c R > P > Q (formal Vieta only)
reason: 3cos2θ + 5sin2θ ≤ √34 ≈ 5.83 < 7, so the equation has NO real θ; key c only follows formally from Vieta on the complex roots of 5t² − 5t + 2 = 0 (P = 1, Q = 2/5, R = 5/3)
work: t = tanθ: 3(1 − t²) + 10t = 7(1 + t²) ⇒ 5t² − 5t + 2 = 0, discriminant 25 − 40 < 0 ⇒ no real solutions
